youtube_description: There are lots of obvious places to metal detect like parks, yards, homesteads, beaches etc.  Have you ever tried detecting hillsides that are in key areas?  We do just that in this episode of Dirty Money metal detecting.  It turns out pretty great and we end up bumping into a small home stead at the bottom of the hill.  We would have never found it had we not taken a chance on detecting the hillside.
youtube_title: Metal detecting those less obvious places! Ep 304 #metaldetecting #treasure #metaldetectingtips
